measurementsDeferredToOperatorCostedReRu.name: J1 QA subset (120-item) cross-judge with the KG lane meaningfully ON
measurementsDeferredToOperatorCostedReRu.why: The shipped qa-judge-harness.bench.test.ts constructs createMemoryRecall WITHOUT a tripleStore dep and WITHOUT a lanes.graphSpread config (verified by grep). Running `pnpm bench:memory qa` as-built reproduces the Phase-98 baseline with the KG lane DORMANT — a NULL result for the headline, not a KG-ON measurement. Making the costed QA cross-judge measure KG-ON requires FIRST (a) wiring the tripleStore + graphSpread config into the QA harness AND (b) populating memory_triples over the 120-item J1 corpus via the offline triple-extraction job, which itself needs an injected (costed) LLM extractor pass over every memory. That harness extension is beyond this regression-gate plan's scope. Therefore the costed QA cross-judge with the lane ON is an OPERATOR COSTED RE-RUN, scheduled after the QA harness is wired (a Phase-100 gap-closure or a follow-on plan).
